nameNote: title only appears as the comic sign 展画 (畫展) in turn/game01 frame0; no text string in exe
portraits: 4 sprites dat\MiniGame\01\{player[i]+4}.spr (= character01..06 of the 4 player slots), then 6 random swaps (rand%4 ↔ rand%4) → slot s solves portrait P[s]
tileLayers: for each of 48 cells: layer0 = P[s] frame cell (correct), layer1/layer2 = random frame (rand%48) of a random portrait index != s; state[cell]=0
scramble: for each row r (0..5): column c=rand%8, state[r*8+c] = rand%2+1 → exactly one wrong cell per row (6 wrong cells)
win: first slot whose 48 states sum to 0 → winner; banner FINISH; board mode → word-card result for winner; standalone → back
timeout: 1200 ticks → TIME IS UP, no winner, no reward

controls.keyboard/joystick: all actions fire on key-UP (release) events: key2 ← (x-1 wrap 8), key3 → (x+1 wrap 8), key4 ↑ (y-1 wrap 6), key5 ↓ (y+1 wrap 6), key0/key1 → cycle cell; each plays drip.wav vol 0x40 (FUN_00419d00)
controls.mouse: every 15 ticks: if mouse inside own board, target=((mx-bx)/30,(my-by)/30) and cursor steps 1 cell toward it (x first, then y); when cursor==target and button 0/1 released → cycle (FUN_00419bc0)

ai.logic: if cursor at target → cycle that cell; if it becomes 0 clear target. else if no target row: up to 5 tries pick rand%6 row containing a non-zero cell; then up to 5 tries pick rand%8 col with non-zero cell; step cursor 1 cell toward target (x first, then y) with drip.wav

background: minigame/01/bg.png frame0 at (W/2,H/2); 01/bg frame1 (80x80) tiled to fill whole screen first (FUN_0041a0e0)
